speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of this generalized rash on your newborn, and when did you first notice it?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis. The history of maternal gonorrhea combined with a sudden onset of a generalized rash in a 4-day-old is highly suggestive of disseminated gonococcal infection. I am requesting a Gram stain and culture of skin lesions, along with a maternal NAAT for confirmation.
